environment.description: Producer-side API endpoint fronted by an internal NLB with a custom TCP flow-rate limiter implemented via iptables hashlimit module (--hashlimit-above 1/sec --hashlimit-burst 1 --hashlimit-mode srcip,dstport) on the NLB target instances, combined with an SQS SendMessage IAM policy condition that includes a StringEquals on aws:RequestTag/idempotencyToken requiring a value matching a server-generated HMAC-SHA256 nonce (valid for 2s TTL, single-use tracked in ElastiCache). The queue itself is configured with ContentBasedDeduplication disabled but the IAM policy's condition key aws:TagKeys ForAllValues check ensures no message can be sent without the verified nonce tag. ElastiCache cluster (Redis 7.x, cluster-mode enabled, 3 shards) maintains a sliding window counter per source principal ARN with a hard cap of 1 SendMessage action per redemptionId per 60-second window, enforced via a Lua script that performs SETNX with PX expiry atomically.

elasticache_dedup.lua_script: local key = KEYS[1]; local result = redis.call('SET', key, '1', 'NX', 'PX', 60000); if result then return 1 else return 0 end
